title: Profitable Residential Real Estate Seeking Loan in Thiruvananthapuram, India
tagline: The business focuses on developing sustainable and premium residential communities in Thiruvananthapuram. - Revenue model: Generates revenue through villa and apartment sales, using construction-linked payments and phased project launches. - The business generates high revenue through premium villa and apartment sales, while relying on project-based contractors and construction partners rather than maintaining a large permanent workforce. - Business also has a partnership with a construction contractor through a separate development venture. - Company has received recognition from Startup India–DPIIT and Kerala Startup Mission. - The promoters include an architect and two civil engineers with over 15 years of experience across India, Oman, and Saudi Arabia.
